hypothesis: The immutable dense experts may benefit from a fully deterministic row-local repertoire selector. The structured component of the independently pitch-label-selected recipe avoids CatBoost GPU probability drift while retaining current-season mix and completed-history pitcher-by-hand-count tilt.

relationship_to_prior_work.dense_experts: Reuse V5_DENSE_PITCHTYPE_MOE_V1 source expert predictions without retraining.
relationship_to_prior_work.selector_source: Use the structured component and hyperparameters inside the frozen V5_ROW_LOCAL_PITCHMIX_SELECTOR recipe; no control target chose this follow-up selector.
relationship_to_prior_work.locked_catboost_followup: V5_DENSE_MOE_LOCKED_SELECTOR failed its strict reproduction gate before control metrics, so none of its control labels or metrics are used.

selector.type: deterministic structured probability; no fitted selector model

candidate.blend_formula: F rows remain exact parent; on R, parent + gamma * (structured-selector dense-MoE - parent)
candidate.selection: maximize minimum full gain across 2020/2021, then minimum R gain, then smaller gamma

source_gate.on_pass: Freeze gamma and recipe before 2022/2023; do not open 2024 until development and honest-anchor gates pass.
